changeSet.author: meetup-flow-agent
changeSet.comment: Точные повторы сообщений отбрасываются уникальным индексом (partial: NULL не занимает слот).
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_inbox_messages_idempotency_key ON inbox_messages (idempotency_key) WHERE idempotency_key IS NOT NULL

changeSet.author: meetup-flow-agent
changeSet.comment: RetryPoller сканирует только WAITING_RETRY с наступившим next_retry_at.
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_flows_waiting_retry ON flows (status, next_retry_at) WHERE status = 'WAITING_RETRY'

changeSet.author: meetup-flow-agent
changeSet.comment: seq уникален в рамках флоу — основа replay-SSE по Last-Event-ID.
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_flow_steps_flow_seq ON flow_steps (flow_id, seq)

changeSet.author: meetup-flow-agent
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_events_starts_at ON events (starts_at)

changeSet.author: meetup-flow-agent
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_events_embedding_hnsw ON events USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops)

changeSet.author: meetup-flow-agent
changeSet.comment: OutboxPoller сканирует только PENDING-доставки с наступившим next_retry_at.
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_outbox_deliveries_pending ON outbox_deliveries (status, next_retry_at) WHERE status = 'PENDING'
